candidates.units: Lodge suites, cottages, Saddle Club rail cars and cabins, glamping teepees/wagons, RV and tent sites. Occupancy per unit above (4 or 6).
candidates.kitchen: Per the engine's room details: Rail Car, Grand Cabin and 2BR Cottage = "Full Kitchen"; Studio Cabin and 1BR Cottage = "Kitchenette" (1BR Cottage: two-burner cooktop + fridge). CAUTION on the Lodge Premium Suite: the engine says "Full Kitchen" but an independent inspection of the room details (Oct 14) found only a mini fridge — do not count on cooking there. Fridge/freezer sizes and ovens are otherwise not stated — confirm by phone before relying on a unit for a multi-family cook. Grills: official rules on portable grills/propane not found on the booking pages — UNKNOWN; ask. Last year's folio shows a golf cart as a separate $74.90 charge — plan for it as an extra.
candidates.activities_included: River Country Water Park and Cowboy Adventure Park access daily — included on every rate plan shown for these dates (plan text). NOTE a conflict on the official site: the terms/FAQ say the water park is covered by the $49.99 resort fee, while the water park rules page says it is "not included with the reservation or room rate for most guests" — the quoted rate plans do say included; confirm with the plan at booking. Water park rules prohibit food, drinks and coolers inside.
candidates.activities_paid: Horseback (45 min) $64.95, ages 8+; airboat $44.95 adult / $39.95 child; swamp buggy same; trap & skeet, archery, zip line, mechanical bull and others are paid à la carte (prices on the activities page). Saturday-night rodeo only — both proposed stays (Sun–Wed, Sun–Thu) miss it. Archery is a paid activity on the 2026 page; any memory of it being free is historical, not a 2027 inclusion.
candidates.schedule: Mid-week January: water park and adventure park are stated as daily; horseback/airboat/buggy run on daily schedules (book at the ranch); rodeo Saturdays only. Weather closures and refunds for weather are not stated on the booking pages — unknown; ask at booking.
candidates.cancel: See itemized quotes: prepaid plans are non-refundable; "Fall Into Savings" plans are free to cancel until 4:00 PM 7 days before arrival.
candidates.group: Group lodge rates page + sales line (do not call for this exercise): https://www.westgateresorts.com/hotels/florida/river-ranch/westgate-river-ranch-resort/groups-meetings/group-lodge/ — Westgate's group booking page says groups of 10+ rooms can book with discounts. Unit clustering (adjacent rail cars/suites) is a request, not a guarantee — ask the group desk. Availability for several units was NOT checked (the engine shows one unit at a time).
candidates.gathering: Lodge suites sit in one building; rail cars are a row along the Saddle Club; fire pits and communal areas exist on the ranch (official overview) — a minyan/evening spot is plausible but not verified for January.
candidates.indoor: Lodge suites and cottages are indoor units with full kitchens — good cold-snap fallback. Rail cars are compact.
candidates.grocery: Nearest full supermarkets are in Lake Wales (~20 min). Grocery delivery to the ranch is not confirmed — bring essentials and water on arrival day. Nearest Chabad: Lakeland (~1 h 20 by OSRM); no kosher restaurant nearby. No kosher certification of anything on site is claimed.
candidates.benchmark: Historical benchmark only (Jan 18–20 2026 folio): $487.20 lodging + resort fee + tax for 2 nights, plus $74.90 golf cart = $562.10. Not a 2027 rate.
sources: Booking engine, Jan 24–27 (read 9:28 AM ET Oct 14 2026)
Water park page: "included in your reservation"
Water park rules: "not included… for most guests"; no food/coolers
candidates.verdict: The closest match to the brief (ranch + many on-site activities + units that sleep 6, several with full kitchens), with exact-date prices verified. Downsides: borderline drive, resort fee + 12% tax add roughly 45% to the room line on the refundable plan, the rodeo is Saturday-only, the Premium Suite's kitchen is in doubt, and grill rules are unknown.

candidates.units: Premium 1BR Cottage (queen + queen sleeper, sleeps 4); Premium 2BR (queen, bunk set, queen sleeper); many Deluxe Cabins (1–2 bedrooms, bunks, sleeper sofas); Camping Cabins (no bath/kitchen). Official lodging page.
candidates.kitchen: VERIFIED on the official lodging page: Premium 1BR Cottage and Premium 2BR list Full Kitchen, Full Bath, patio, FIRE PIT and GAS GRILL. Every Deluxe Cabin listed says Partial Kitchen (refrigerator, cooktop, microwave, toaster, sink, cookware) or No Kitchen, and "No Grill" (fire ring or fire pit only). Fridge/freezer size not stated. Rules for bringing your own propane grill/griddle: not stated — unknown; ask.
candidates.activities_included: Two pools (one with kiddie pool, one with hot tub), 9-hole par-34 golf course (tee times; cart rental limited), 2 lit tennis + 6 pickleball courts, mini golf, fitness center, 20,000 sq ft air-conditioned convention center (bingo, exercise classes, concerts in season), live music Fri/Sat at the Shanty Lounge. PLAYGROUND: "currently unavailable" (official recreation page, read Oct 14). Themed family activities are stated for summer weekends (mid-May–Labor Day) — late January is the snowbird program, so expect adult-leaning scheduled activities on weekdays.
candidates.activities_paid: Golf (greens/cart fees), golf cart rentals, boat ramp/fishing guides (off-site), kayak/boat rentals if offered — prices not captured.
candidates.schedule: Open year-round; winter is peak season for the RV resort. Weekday January programming = seasonal (snowbird) activities; verify the January calendar. Weather refund terms: KOA cancellation policy applies (see below); no weather clause found.
candidates.cancel: By phone (Oct 14, verbal): one-night deposit; cancel up to 14 days before arrival for a refund minus a $20 fee.
candidates.group: Groups page: https://koa.com/campgrounds/okeechobee/groups/ (group facilities, rally hall). Cabin clustering: Premium cottages are a small set; ask the campground how many premium units exist and whether they are adjacent.
candidates.gathering: Convention center and pavilions on site (indoor fallback for cold/wind). Fire pits at the premium units; communal evening space likely at the pavilion — not verified for January use.
candidates.indoor: Yes — the air-conditioned/heated convention center, lounge and indoor units.
candidates.grocery: Walmart Supercenter and Publix in Okeechobee (~10 min); grocery delivery likely reaches the resort (Walmart delivery radius) — unverified; bring day-one essentials and water. Chabad listed in Okeechobee (Chabad.org directory). No kosher certification claimed.
sources: Official lodging page (unit features incl. grill/kitchen)
candidates.verdict: Would have been the best in-range value (real kitchens + gas grills + fire pits in the Premium units, pools/golf/courts, 2 h away) — but the office says the Premium / full-kitchen units are NOT available for either stay (phone, Oct 14). Only partial-kitchen, no-grill Deluxe cabins could remain; January programming is snowbird-oriented and the playground is down. Dropped from the top 3.
